from collections import defaultdict, deque

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                color=grid[r][c]; comp=[]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in (-1,0,1):
                        for db in (-1,0,1):
                            na,nb=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=na<R and 0<=nb<C and grid[na][nb]==color and (na,nb) not in seen:
                                seen.add((na,nb)); stack.append((na,nb))
                comps[color].append(comp)
    for color,parts in comps.items():
        if len(parts)!=2: continue
        parts=sorted(parts,key=lambda p:sum(r for r,c in p)/len(p))
        first,second=parts
        start=max(first,key=lambda rc:(rc[0],rc[1]))
        end=second[0] if len(second)==1 else max(second,key=lambda rc:(rc[0],-rc[1]))
        r,c=start
        while r<end[0] and c<end[1]:
            r+=1;c+=1;out[r][c]=color
        while r!=end[0] or c!=end[1]:
            r += (end[0]>r)-(end[0]<r)
            c += (end[1]>c)-(end[1]<c)
            out[r][c]=color
        r,c=end
        while r>0 and c<C-1:
            r-=1;c+=1;out[r][c]=color
